title: Hi very new here. First time on Reddit. I heard of this thread from tiktok
content: Wanna say I find it hilarious that we are more likely than not learning while we sleep. I’ve always been so confused and frustrated by the seemingly bizarre gap in understanding I come across regarding everyday conversations. I’ve never been an A-straight student and certainly never excited to be in the classroom. I find it fascinating that there are many people with this inherit calling to delve deeper. I wish you all safe travels 🩷 Hoping this has something to do with the restoration of humanity
